mathematical_contract.axis_content: For one tensor variable x, view the trivariate polynomial as a polynomial in the other two variables whose coefficients are univariate fibers in x. Their exact polynomial GCD is precisely the largest supported univariate factor in x shared by the whole tensor. Structurally zero fibers are omitted and a constant GCD makes no claim.
mathematical_contract.division: Every fiber is divided by the content through Hypersolve exact polynomial division. The quotient is accepted only when every remainder is structurally zero; unsupported coefficients, overflow, or a failed division abandon the optional reduction without changing the predicate result.
mathematical_contract.factor_sign: Each extracted univariate factor is evaluated at its authored selected parameter with the STRICT algebraic-root sign authority. A selected zero proves the original tensor zero. Decided nonzero signs are multiplied exactly; an unresolved factor sign can support only a primitive zero proof, never a nonzero sign claim.
mathematical_contract.primitive_replay: After all three axis contents are stripped, the existing STRICT structural, Bernstein, affine selected-root, linear-axis resultant, and binary selected-root authorities are replayed on the primitive tensor. A primitive zero is independent of unresolved nonzero cofactor signs.
mathematical_contract.resource_bound: All dimension arithmetic is checked and preserves the existing 16384-control ceiling. Axis division can only shrink the selected dimension. Fibers and the reconstructed quotient are retained only for the duration of the cold symbolic cut.
mathematical_contract.policy: The separably obscured identity is Certified under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 without terminal consumption. The coupled-factor control remains Predicate uncertainty in STRICT and may be reported Zero only after APPROXIMATE_512 records Approximate512Consumed.
mathematical_contract.failure: No tolerance, sampled factorization, guessed sign, compatibility shim, or alternate Boolean engine is introduced.

capability.comparison_revision: The exact zero (a*b-c*(a+b))*(1+a)*(1+b)*(1+c), with independently represented cubic roots and c=a*b/(a+b), was quadratic in every tensor axis. Pairwise sum/product recognition could not expose the rational relation, so STRICT was uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 consumed its terminal.
capability.source_revision: Exact axis-content extraction removes (1+a), (1+b), and (1+c), proves their selected signs positive, and exposes the multi-affine primitive a*b-c*(a+b) to the existing linear-axis resultant authority.
capability.certified_fixture: The formerly terminal rational three-field fixture returns Certified Zero under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512; neither policy consumes the approximate terminal.
capability.exact_reconstruction: The test directly verifies that stripping all three factors reconstructs exactly the authored primitive coefficient tensor and accumulates a Positive cofactor sign.
capability.remaining_policy_control: Multiplication by the strictly positive cube cofactor 1+a*b+a*c+b*c couples every tensor axis. It has no nonconstant univariate axis content; STRICT remains explicitly uncertain and APPROXIMATE_512 returns Zero only with Approximate512Consumed.
capability.remaining_exactness_boundary: Extract bounded multivariate factors or construct a bounded compositum only after quotient reduction, affine/resultant relations, selected sum/product relations, and univariate tensor content all fail.

benchmark.primary_method: all-feature release unit-test and comparative executables pinned to CPU 11; exact fully-qualified filters; seven perf-stat repetitions for focused fixtures and three for fixed-work controls; median retired instructions and branches are primary

fixed_work_historical_controls.method: current release comparative executable pinned to CPU 11; three complete perf-stat repetitions; fixture construction excluded
fixed_work_historical_controls.interpretation: Both established offset lanes remain instruction-neutral. Each executable run acquired the same roughly 406K additional startup instructions while the cold axis-content path remained unreachable.

competitive_context.method: current release comparative executable pinned to CPU 11; 11 complete samples at a 100 ms target; fixture construction excluded
competitive_context.interpretation: Cavalier and Curvo remain throughput targets rather than exactness peers. Retired-instruction controls, not loaded-host wall time, establish that the new proof is isolated from ordinary offset lanes.

separable_rational_three_field_zero.interpretation: The certified path eliminates 701,022 allocation calls and 147,514 temporary allocations while reducing peak live heap by 47.27 KiB.

coupled_factor_terminal.interpretation: The intentionally unsupported coupled cofactor retains the 512-bit terminal and identifies the next exactness and allocation boundary.
